decisions.diagnosis: False detections in the Sydney Park Rd west road zone during what looks like works at the intersection: bursts in both directions in working hours with no matching flow in any adjacent zone.
Tail of the works period: westbound still somewhat high and eastbound unusually low; may be real diversion or residual detection problems.
decisions.evidence: 1251 43-95/day vs ~40-60 in Sep 2026; 1275 11-43/day vs ~50-70 before and after.

decisions.diagnosis: Mitchell Rd north-east departures fell to about a quarter for five weeks while the opposite direction was unaffected; could be a lane closure during works or lost tracking in an obstructed zone.
The Mitchell Rd NW path zone recorded almost nothing for four months (path closure or dead zone), so its warning days are left missing rather than restored.
decisions.evidence: 1290 and 1354 fell from ~2-4/day to ~0 (mostly warning zero days, 70-80% of slots), unaffected by the 2024-11-08 step, and resumed from 2025-01-17.

summary: One Secure Agility camera (C0001601) at Sydney Park Rd & Mitchell Rd, St Peters, with 11 zones and 22 directions from 2024-03-25. The record is mostly sound: the installation day is dropped, TfNSW 'warning' days (whole zero days in a working camera) are restored as zeros, and false detections in the Sydney Park Rd west road zone during apparent works in late July to mid August 2026 are set missing. A camera-wide step up of about 1.8x on 2024-11-08 marks a detection change, so each direction is split into series before and after that date.
